title: Agent Binding
description: The concrete 'an agent can be bound to a task' object (Core Model §02, business plan §6). Referenced as agent.* in a task's performed_by. The binding names the MCP tool and model; WHAT it may do is never on the binding — that lives on the Guardrail Policy the task resolves, so behavior changes by editing a policy, not redeploying a binding. LOCKED for Phase 1.

task_ref.description: The task this agent is bound to.

mcp_tool.description: The MCP tool/server the agent acts through. For any guardrailed task this must be the only sanctioned path to the actionable system (§11 bypass risk).

model.description: Model identifier the binding runs on, e.g. claude-opus-4-8. Recorded for audit/repro, not for enforcement.

guardrail_ref.description: Usually null — the effective guardrail is resolved from the task/process. Set only to pin a binding-specific override.
